claims.claim: Useful work is nonnegative for nonnegative stage work and useful fractions.
The modeled dissipative remainder is nonnegative when stage fractions are no greater than one.
Useful work plus the modeled remainder equals total supplied work exactly.
Each partition term is no greater than total supplied work under the stated bounds.
A common efficiency ceiling bounds useful work and implies a necessary supplied-work floor for a declared target.
Exact nonzero partition and target-floor witnesses are inhabited.
The exact-rational package regression passes its captured checks.
Work units, boundaries, useful-output definitions, fixed fractions, additive stages, and the [0,1] range are supplied assumptions.
Any entropy production, exergy destruction, ecosystem recovery, planetary habitability, causal benefit, adoption, delivery, payment, or revenue is established.

high_risk_claims.support: A declared accounting remainder only, not measured heat, entropy production, exergy destruction, or ecological harm.
A supplied operational classification requiring an external measurement protocol.
Necessary only inside the fixed additive ledger under a supplied common efficiency ceiling; not sufficient for ecological success.
Application framing only; no planet, ecosystem, intervention, or habitability condition is modeled.
